verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export capability for LightSprint's own data (tasks, plans, previews, audit logs, skills) in open formats. The 'No lock-in' claim refers only to model and API-key choice. GitHub-backed code delivery and self-hosting are adjacent features, not a product export path, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
